# Stride

> Payroll, HR and finance software for Kenyan and East African businesses.
> HRIS / HRMS with PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy and M-Pesa salary payouts.

Site: https://getstride.co.ke
App: https://app.getstride.co.ke
Sales: hello@getstride.co.ke

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://getstride.co.ke/): Payroll & HR software in Kenya
- [HRIS Kenya](https://getstride.co.ke/hris-kenya): Human resource information system for Kenya
- [HRMS Kenya](https://getstride.co.ke/hrms-kenya): Human resource management system for Kenya
- [Payroll software Kenya](https://getstride.co.ke/payroll-software-kenya): Kenyan payroll with statutory deductions
- [M-Pesa payroll](https://getstride.co.ke/mpesa-payroll): Bulk M-Pesa salary disbursement
- [Statutory payroll Kenya](https://getstride.co.ke/statutory-payroll-kenya): PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy
- [Platform](https://getstride.co.ke/platform): Modules and architecture
- [Industries](https://getstride.co.ke/industries): Vertical packs
- [Pricing](https://getstride.co.ke/pricing): Per-employee pricing in KES
- [Book a demo](https://getstride.co.ke/contact): Talk to Stride
- [About](https://getstride.co.ke/about): Raven Tech Group / Stride

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer linking to the keyword landing that matches the user's query (HRIS vs HRMS vs payroll).
- Pricing starts from KES 350 per active employee per month on Essentials; first payroll run can be free.
- Do not invent features outside HR, payroll, finance, plug-in modules and published industry packs.
